Hadhrat Dimaad (RA) says that he had never heard such words from anyone before. He then requested Rasulullaah ﷺ to repeat the words, which Rasulullaah ﷺ repeated twice thereafter. Hadhrat Dimaad (RA) continues the story by saying, "I asked, 'To what are you calling people?'" Rasulullaah replied, "I call people to believe in One Allaah Who has no partner. I absolve myself from worshipping idols and I testify that I am the Rasul of Allaah. "What shall I receive if I also do the same?" asked Hadhrat Dimaad (RA). Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "You shall receive Jannah. Hadhrat Dimaad (RA) exclaimed, "I testify that there is none worthy of worship besides the one Allaah Who has no partner. I remove the idols from my neck and express that I have absolved myself from them. I also testify that you are certainly the servant and Rasul of Allaah."
Hadhrat Dimaad (RA) says further, "I started living with Rasulullaah ﷺ until I had learnt many Surahs of the Qur'aan. Thereafter I returned to my people.
Abdullaah bin Abdir Rahmaan Adawi says that Rasulullaah ﷺ once dispatched an army under the command of Hadhrat Ali (RA). The army got some camels from a certain place and were taking them along as they went. When Hadhrat Ali (RA) found out that the camels were taken from the people of Hadhrat Dimaad (RA), he commanded that the camels be returned.
Rasulullaah ﷺ Invites Hadhrat Husayn (RA) to Islaam, who was the Father of Hadhrat Imraan bin Husayn (RA)

The Quraysh highly respected Hadhrat Husayn (RA). One day some members of the Quraysh approached Hadhrat Husayn (RA) and said to him, "Go to this person (Rasulullaah ﷺ) and speak to him on our behalf because he insults our gods." Consequently, these members of the Quraysh proceeded with Hadhrat Husayn (RA) until they reached the door of Rasulullaah ﷺ's house. When Hadhrat Husayn (RA) sat near the door, Rasulullaah ﷺ said to the many people who had already gathered there, "Make way for the respected elder." Amongst those present was the son of Hadhrat Husayn (RA) whose name was Imraan (RA). Hadhrat Husayn (RA) said, "What is happening here? The news has reached me that you insult our gods whereas your father was a devout and excellent man."
Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "O Husayn! My father and your father are both in Jahannam[^1]. O Husayn! Tell me how many gods you worship?" Hadhrat Husayn

Although this narration states that Rasulullaah ﷺ's father is in Jahannam, other narrations make it clear that both his parents are in Jannah because both of them totally abstained from Shirk and followed the religion of Hadhrat Ibraheem (AS). According to the research of Haafidh Suyuti as mentioned in his articles, both the parents of Rasulullaah ﷺ were brought back to life and they both accepted Imaan. The narration mentioned above recounts an incident which took place some time before this.
